facts.input: Teeth3DS-style upper/lower OBJ directory layout; arbitrary STL/OBJ support is not demonstrated
facts.preprocessing: SAM3 plus reversible_rasterizer mesh rendering and face/pixel relation; dataset-specific structure
facts.output: prediction visualization and exported JSON; source includes instance masks and FDI classifier
facts.correspondence: reversible rasterizer is intended to relate rendered pixels to mesh faces, but exact original-face/vertex preservation was not validated
facts.confidence: SAM3/VLM scores may exist but no stable ToothInstance confidence contract
facts.fdi: external VLM classifier; --disable-gpt removes FDI classification
facts.api: README requires OPENAI_API_KEY or ARK_API_KEY; documented models chatgpt-5.2 and doubao-seed 1.8; no paid API called
facts.sam3: README does not pin a SAM3 version; requires separate SAM3 install and weights; GitHub API reports license Other/NOASSERTION
facts.vram: not documented; Python >=3.12, PyTorch >=2.7, CUDA >=12.6, C++17, OpenGL

facts.state: project/baseline implementation, not a complete production inference package
facts.input: prepared Teeth3DS point data; README describes 60000-point processed scans
facts.output: point-wise tooth labels; planned instance postprocessing, landmarks, and geometry are explicitly future project phases
facts.preprocessing: dataset download, patient splits, prepare_data; no STL command
facts.checkpoint: README references OUTPUT_DIR-generated best.pt after training, not a released artifact
facts.FDI: project plan says FDI point-wise labels but no verified exported FDI contract

facts.input: separate upper/lower OBJ named casename_upper.obj/casename_lower.obj with required axis orientation
facts.preprocessing: farthest-point sampling; inference can sample original OBJ internally
facts.output: challenge-format JSON files, same format as ground truth; instance and FDI labeling challenge semantics
facts.checkpoint: Google Drive ckpts(new).zip linked by README; not downloaded
facts.runtime: PyTorch 1.7.1 CUDA 11.0 image, custom pointops, batch size 1, minimum 11 GB GPU; RTX40 issues noted
facts.correspondence: JSON is indexed against sampled mesh/challenge format; original full-face correspondence requires validation
facts.license: no repository LICENSE; checkpoint terms absent; referenced 3DTeethSeg dataset rights are separate and non-commercial terms require review

facts.checkpoint: best.pt is an output of training; no released weight found
facts.registry_result: No other additional model with an obtainable pretrained 3D intraoral instance/FDI inference artifact was identified in this repository

facts.output: PLY meshes, JSON labels, JPG overlays; instance metrics TLA/TSA/TIR

facts.runtime: CUDA/nvcc, CMake >=3.27, OpenGL/EGL, PointNet2 CUDA extensions
facts.fdi: not documented as a stable output field

benchmark_gate.all_requirements: Only TGNet currently has documented real 3D intraoral input, obtainable author-linked pretrained inference, plausible individual tooth/FDI output, and enough documentation for a meaningful isolated benchmark. It remains blocked pending checkpoint retrieval and license review.

reasons.TSegAgent: requires SAM3 access/weights and external VLM API keys; no paid API call authorized
reasons.OrthoGeo3D / OrthoTwin3D: roadmap/in-training baseline with no released checkpoint
reasons.Unified benchmark DGCNN baseline: no released checkpoint and semantic output
reasons.THISNet: no checkpoint and CUDA-only test path
